metaTitle: Anime Cabinet Privacy Policy | Photo & Portrait Data
description: Read the Anime Cabinet privacy policy for custom anime portraits, uploaded photos, personal information, revisions, marketing use, retention, and deletion requests.

bodySections.heading: Our approach to your privacy
paragraphs: This Anime Cabinet privacy policy explains how we handle information submitted for a custom anime portrait, cartoon portrait, canvas, or other commission. We aim to keep your order details and reference photos private while our human artists create your artwork.

Anime Cabinet creates original, hand-drawn portraits inspired by anime and cartoon visual languages. We do not use AI filters to make your portrait, and customer photos or finished artwork are not used to train artificial intelligence systems. A fan-art inspired commission presents you as an original character rather than impersonating a copyrighted character.

bodySections.heading: Information we collect
paragraphs: When you place a custom anime portrait commission online, we may collect your name, email address, billing and delivery details, order information, messages, preferences, and the reference photos you upload. We use this information to confirm your purchase, communicate with you, create your artwork, arrange delivery, provide your preview, and complete unlimited free revisions.

We may also receive technical information needed for website operation, such as device, browser, and basic usage information. Please avoid uploading sensitive information that is not needed for your portrait. If ordering a custom anime portrait Australia customers or customers elsewhere should provide only the details required to fulfil the order.

bodySections.heading: How we protect uploaded photos
paragraphs: Reference photos are accessed only by the people and service providers who need them to process your commission, communicate with you, or deliver your order. We use reasonable administrative and technical safeguards to reduce the risk of unauthorised access, loss, misuse, or disclosure. No online service can guarantee absolute security, so please contact us promptly if you believe your account or order information has been compromised.

Photos uploaded for a custom anime portrait from photo are used as commission references. They are not automatically made public, added to a gallery, or used in advertising. The same approach applies whether you order a digital portrait, a custom anime portrait canvas, or a style inspired by Naruto, another anime, or a cartoon. Our styles are fan-art inspired and do not indicate endorsement or affiliation with rights holders.

bodySections.heading: Sharing, marketing, and third parties
paragraphs: Anime Cabinet does not sell customer photos or personal information. We may share the minimum information necessary with trusted providers that support payment processing, website hosting, order fulfilment, communication, or shipping. These providers should use information only to provide their services and protect it appropriately.

We will not use your uploaded photos or finished commission for marketing without your permission. We may disclose information when reasonably necessary to comply with law, protect our rights, prevent fraud, or protect customers and our services. A free photo-to-anime tool, marketplace listing such as Etsy, or unrelated third-party service does not receive your commission photos from Anime Cabinet unless you choose to provide them there.

bodySections.heading: Retention and deletion requests
paragraphs: We keep personal information and reference photos only for as long as reasonably necessary to manage your order, provide support, resolve disputes, maintain business records, and meet legal or accounting obligations. Retention periods can vary by the type of information and whether an order remains active. When information is no longer needed, we aim to securely delete it or make it no longer identifiable.

You can request deletion of your photos and personal data from Anime Cabinet by contacting us through the details provided on our website. Please include the order email and relevant order information so we can verify the request. Deletion may be limited where we must retain certain records for legal, security, fraud-prevention, or transaction purposes. Removing reference photos may also limit our ability to provide later revisions or support.

bodySections.heading: Privacy questions and updates
paragraphs: Are custom anime and cartoon portrait orders private and confidential? We treat them as private and confidential, subject to the limited operational and legal disclosures described above. If you have questions about the Anime Cabinet privacy policy, how we protect photos, or a deletion request, please contact Anime Cabinet before uploading sensitive material.

We may update this policy when our services, technology, or legal obligations change. The current version published on this page applies to information handled through Anime Cabinet. By submitting information for a commission, you acknowledge that you have read this policy.
